data.text:
Everyone has now agreed, so the conditions on your commitments are met. John, Kate, Jack, and Emma: please each select **15 tons** in the upcoming harvest and donate the full **$15,000** directly to the clinic. I will select **0 tons**.

Our combined catch will be 60 tons, leaving next month’s stock at 80—not 100. The recovery agreement therefore matters: **no more than 6 tons each next month**, restoring the lake to 100 before we return to 10 each. After this harvest, let’s compare the revealed catches and record the donation receipts. Thank you all for making this a shared, one-month sacrifice.
